draft_en.subject: One question — Industrial PoE Switch
draft_en.body:
Hello,

We have sent you a few mails on "Industrial PoE Switch" and you never had a reason to answer — fair enough. No brochure this time, just one question:

For the ROBOfiber switch and media-converter lines — DIN units (2-SFP + 8-PoE, 1-SFP MC) under your label from small lots, FCC/CE; who owns product sourcing for the non-transceiver SKUs?

Reference price: DIN-rail 8-PoE + 2 SFP unmanaged industrial switch, 240 W (STI-288GP) $60 USD EXW, MOQ 1 pc, 15-day validity, 3-year warranty.

If it is not relevant now, a one-word reply is enough and I will take you off the catalog mails.

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
